title: CRCHUM-CITADEL/nextflow-sante-precision pipeline parameters
description: Pipeline Nextflow pour besoin des projets santé de précision

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

genomic_samplesheet.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
genomic_samplesheet.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with X columns, and a header row.

clinical_samplesheet.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
clinical_samplesheet.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 4 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

mode.description: The pipeline mode you'd like to run. Either 'clinical', 'genomic', or 'both'

type.description: Sequencing data type for the genomic workflow. Either 'both' (DNA+RNA, default) or 'dna-only'. In 'dna-only' mode, RNA-derived processing (Isofox expression/fusion, SAGE RNA-append integration) is skipped entirely, even if RNA files are present.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

ensembl_annotations.description: BioMart TSV for PURPLE CNV gene-to-Entrez mapping and ESVEE breakpoint gene annotation.

ensembl_annotations_expr.description: BioMart TSV for Isofox expression Ensembl-to-Entrez ID mapping.

genome_reference.description: Genome reference FASTA (GRCh38) — required for vcf2maf.

sample_registrations.description: Path to sample_registrations.csv for template clinical output (used when no clinical_samplesheet is provided).

study_id.description: Study identifier used for meta_study.txt name and the top-level output folder for all files.

project_description.description: Project description used for the desc value of meta_study.txt.

cosmic_data.description: Path to COSMIC fusion TSV for ML SV processing.

chimer_data.description: Path to ChimerKB Excel file for ML SV processing.

hotspots_data.description: Path to a pre-downloaded cancerhotspots.org single-residue hotspots JSON (https://www.cancerhotspots.org/api/hotspots/single) for ML mutation processing. If empty, fetched at runtime (requires internet on compute nodes).

cosmic_reference.description: Path to COSMIC v3.6 mutational signature reference ZIP.

sbs_metadata.description: Path to COSMIC SBS metadata TSV.

dbs_metadata.description: Path to COSMIC DBS metadata TSV.

id_metadata.description: Path to COSMIC ID (indel) metadata TSV.

cancer_type.description: Cancer type abbreviation for cBioPortal (e.g. mixed, lung, brca).

mohccn_primary_site_map.description: Path to MOHCCN primary site mapping CSV (ICD-O topography codes).

mohccn_specimen_tissue_source_map.description: Path to MOHCCN specimen tissue source mapping CSV.

mohccn_treatment_intent_map.description: Path to MOHCCN treatment intent mapping CSV.
